summary: Index into locations.location where the vehicle must end its route.
range: Integer in [0, len(location)). If neither end_index nor end_depot_ids is given, the route is open (ends at last task, no return leg).
businessRules: end_index defines: Specify the index of the vehicle’s final stop point in the location array. The valid value range is \[0, length of locations). Please note that if either of the end_index or end_depot_ids is not pr…
Must stay consistent with: locations.location, vehicles.start_index, vehicles.end_depot_ids. Changes here may require validation of those fields.
Rule: Shipments: pickup always occurs before delivery on the route.
Numeric field; verify sign (positive/negative) and unit from spec.
Optional field. Omitting uses solver's default behavior (no penalty).
testingGuidance: Positive: end_index == start_index (closed route, return to origin).
Positive: end_index differs from start_index (distinct end depot).
Interaction: omit end_index -> open route ends at the last served task (no return leg).
Interaction: Negative: a job location_index equal to len(location) -> 400.
Interaction: Negative: a non-integer index like "first" -> 400 type error.
Interaction: Positive: two depots north/south, demand split by region -> each vehicle serves its nearby cluster.
Interaction: Infeasible: job depot_ids incompatible with any vehicle's depots -> unassigned.
